svg.title: A stale summary is corrected against the final diff and version-specific evidence
svg.desc: S1 describes C1 preview-only behavior but C2 adds a replacement writer. The C1-to-C2 source delta and reference checks inform S2, which describes H0-to-C2, cites D7 and current checks, and leaves integration pending. All identifiers are fictional.
svg.text: A summary must describe the version being proposed

A corrected description does not create approval or integration evidence.
